maxBytes.label: 25 MiB
maxBytes.reason: The reader caps an over-limit local read at maxBytes + 1 and the parser returns an explicit limit-reached Inspection.

maxStructures.reason: A 50,000-Structure PNG/WAV stress run stayed below the 128 MiB semantic-heap budget; the 100,000 value did not leave the same memory margin.

maxDiagnostics.reason: Both parsers stop at exactly 1,000 Diagnostics and return limit-reached rather than silently continuing.

slowNoticeMs.reason: A controller profile observes the slow state at roughly two seconds while keeping Abort opening available.

cancellationDeadlineMs.reason: The controller publishes its bounded termination callback about 250 ms after cooperative cancellation.
